summary: Reviewed intermediaries for Fund III. Agreed a briefing programme for six investment consultants, an LP co-invest offer and an agent pack by end of January. The placement agent terms are pending and the Edinburgh pensions roundtable was declined.

discussion.keyPoints: The week 3 plan needs an agent for continental Europe and the Nordics. Two proposals came in at around 2% of capital raised. Richard wants the fee capped.
Natalie said six consultants act as gatekeepers for most UK pension LPs. Westbourne is not rated by any of them.
Several Fund II LPs asked for co-invest. Richard is open to it on larger deals.

recommendations.recommendation: Appoint one placement agent for continental Europe and the Nordics only, at 2% of capital raised with a cap.
Brief the 6 investment consultants that gatekeep UK pension LPs, aiming for a buy rating on Fund III.
Offer Fund III LPs co-invest of up to 20% of equity on deals over £60m EV, with no fee and no carry.
Give the placement agent a pack with the deck, DDQ answers and case studies by end of January.
Host a roundtable for Scottish pension funds at the Edinburgh office.

actions.action: Negotiate the fee cap with the preferred placement agent

nextFocus: Plan LP retention and re-ups from Fund II.
nextPreparation: Bring the Fund II LP list with commitment sizes and last contact dates.

tests.question: What co-invest offer did we agree?
How many investment consultants are we briefing?
Is the placement agent appointment agreed?
